'''Jason Sumrall''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dantooine Regionals]] on 25 June 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court of the Vile Gangster with Tusken Raiders]], according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d943">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-red-81-s-dantooine-regional-report-6-25d943/ red-81-s-dantooine-regional-report-6-25], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-red-81-s-dantooine-regional-report-6-25d943/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
